# Intellible

> Intellible is a win-back intelligence service for B2B teams. We find which lost accounts are worth winning back, why they left, what's changed and how to open the call. Your team makes the call. We never contact your customers.

## Who it is for
Heads, VPs and directors of sales, revenue, customer success, marketing and growth at B2B companies whose own customers are businesses, from SMB to mid-market. Focus: B2B SaaS, fintech, edtech payments, foodtech and cloud kitchen operators. UAE first, then the GCC.

## How it works
You share your lost accounts. We read each account's public signals (leadership changes, funding, launches, hiring), work out the likely reason it left and what has changed since, and rank which ones are worth winning back. For each account you get the reason it left, what changed, why now, who to contact and how to open the call.

## How it starts
Start with an audit to see what your lost accounts are worth. Then keep us running in the background, so none worth winning back slips past again. Book a call to talk scope and pricing: https://calendly.com/vikrant-intellible/30min
